name: Dirty Laundry
source:
Taking a housekeeping job at the Hubert estate should solve two problems: your overdue rent and your desperate need for material for your next crime novel. The salary is obscene, the family is secretive, and Sterling, the maddeningly attractive butler, makes polishing silver feel dangerously unprofessional.

Then you find a dead man in the walk-in freezer, and suddenly you have more material than you bargained for. With secrets lurking behind the spotless surfaces and Sterling proving an inconvenient distraction, keeping your head down might be the hardest part of the job.
